body:
> Decision (a) on #133, 2026-08-28, on measured evidence — see #133's closing comment. #142 already shipped
> `hkb finish` and rewired every prescription; this card is what remains. **Read #142's diff first** and
> drop any item it already covers.

## Why

Worker policy on the default profile is the launch line — `--permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools …
--disallowedTools …` — and hkb's PreToolUse hook stays `KB_TASK`-gated (inert on `claude-bg`). Two things
follow: the launch line must close the gaps a live hook would have closed, and on the profiles where the
hook *is* live (`claude-p`, Actions if the runner honours project hooks) it must never widen the launch
allowlist — a hook `allow` overrides Claude Code's own command-substitution check (measured).

## What

1. **`Bash(hkb dispatch*)` in `--disallowedTools`** on `claude`, `claude-track`, `claude-p`
   (`src/board.js` launch lines) and in `templates/actions/kanban-worker-claude.yml`. Copilot: no deny
   (space-star deny on Copilot is unverified) — put the reason in the prompt instead. One sentence in
   `src/context.js` and `SKILL.md`: *"Never run `hkb dispatch` — it is what dispatched you; a second
   dispatcher double-claims tasks."* Test: the rendered launch line contains the token.
2. **`preToolHook` becomes deny-or-silence.** Emit stdout only on `deny`; on `allow` exit 0 with no
   output, so the native allowlist stays authoritative. When `KB_TASK` is set but `KB_PROFILE` is unset
   or unknown, stand aside with one stderr line — never run the `{}` policy. Gate unchanged.
   Deny wording for a capability denial:
   `hkb: <existing reason>. If the task cannot be done without this, do not work around it — run \`hkb block <n> "needs <what>: <why>" --kind capability\` (describe it, do not paste the command) and stop.`
   Test (`test/hook.test.js`): allow → empty stdout; deny → the JSON; unknown profile → empty stdout + stderr.
3. **Disclose, don't work around — as prompt text.** `src/context.js` + `SKILL.md`: *"If a tool or command
   you need is refused and there is no allowlisted way to do the work, `hkb block <n> "needs <tool>: <why>"
   --kind capability`. A refusal of `hkb complete` itself is never a reason to block — use `hkb finish`."*
4. **`hkb doctor`**: one `warn` when any `claude*` profile's launch lacks `--permission-mode dontAsk`
   ("a prompt in a background worker blocks the attempt"). Keep #139's `permission policy` line as is.
5. **Stale strings**: `src/init.js` HOOK_NOTE/docstring and `docs/harnesses.md` say the Stop hook stands
   aside outside a worker session (`KB_TASK` or the `kb-<n>-<k>` checkout) and PreToolUse is `KB_TASK`
   only, live on process-mode profiles; README drops "file tools confined to the worktree" as a
   default-profile feature. Check what #142 already changed before editing.

## Done when

- `hkb dispatch` from inside a `claude` worker is refused by the launch line, not by hkb.
- On a profile where the hook runs, no tool call is allowed that the launch line would have denied.
- A worker prompt tells the agent to `block --kind capability` rather than route around a refusal.
- `npm run lint && npm test` green; `npm run smoke` (launch/template contents changed).

## Contract

- Blocked by #138, which edits the same `CLAUDE_TOOLS`/launch lines; branch from its merge, not from
  before it. #114 follows this one for the same reason.
- Do not reintroduce a hook `allow`. Do not touch `hkb finish` (#142).
goal: hkb dispatch is denied at launch, the hook never widens the allowlist, and a worker is told to block --kind capability instead of working around a refusal
title: Worker policy is the launch line: close the native gaps, make the hook deny-only
